Scharf Investments Llc decreased its stake in Mckesson Corp (MCK) by 9.14% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 869,584 shares of the other pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $122.50M, down from 957,082 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scharf Investments Llc who had been investing in Mckesson Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $30.08B market cap company.
